name: miles-identity
description: Centralised OAuth 2.1 / OIDC identity provider for LMS, Miles One, Miles Masterclass and Salesforce. Bun-native.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun audit

overridesReason: Transitive advisory fixes. axios: pinned to 1.16.0 by @openfga/sdk, inside the <1.18.0 range. drizzle-orm: pulled in as an optional peer of better-auth; we never import it (AGENTS.md forbids an ORM) but <0.45.2 carries a SQL-injection advisory. lodash: reached only via the auth CLI's Prisma schema parser, which we do not use. Re-check all three on every dependency bump — see prompts/001-config-skeleton.md.
